description: Spec §6.1, for SEDAN, BRUTE and VIPER: the physics Mesh is hidden but keeps refreshing its bones; Body (visible, SM_DF_Car_<X>) rides on Mesh; each wheel (SM_DF_Wheel) rides on Mesh at its wheel bone's socket; the light bar (SEDAN only) and the hidden roof weapon sit on the Body's Roof socket; the shield bubble and the boost flames start hidden. Every part is at world scale 1.
